title.narrative: HIV/AIDS Response for Key Populations and Community TB Programme in High Burden Areas in Liberia

description.narrative: Liberia - TB/HIV - Plan International, Inc. - Plan International Liberia. This program has the following goals: An AIDS-free Liberia, with Zero new infection, Zero AIDS-related death and Zero AIDS-related stigma and discrimination. End TB in Liberia by 2035. The objectives of this program are: By 2025 Reduce New HIV infections to less than 190 per year. To strengthen the surveillance system for early warning, detection, and response to emerging threats/outbreaks. To strengthen the capacity of community systems to respond to outbreaks and emergencies through a patient centered, human rights and gender informed response.. Reduce stigma and discrimination for PLHIV and vulnerable populations to less than 20%. To strengthen human resources for health including Community health workers at the subnational level to improve competency in event-based surveillance and health service delivery. Strengthen and promote leadership, coordination and accountability for the National Response at central and decentralized levels. Strengthen monitoring, reporting and evaluation of the national AIDS response from all sectors. To strengthen laboratory and diagnostic capacity to enable rapid diagnostic testing of new outbreaks, specimen transportation networks, laboratory information systems, antimicrobial resistance (AMR) & Zoonotic diseases in alignment with WHO The Joint External Evaluation (JEE).. Mobilize adequate resources to achieve the goals and objectives of the NSP. To strengthen capacity for case management with a focus on hypoxemia and medical oxygen, respiratory care, and therapeutics.. To strengthen systems for Health product and Waste management. Provide high-quality TB diagnosis and treatment to all patients without their having to incur catastrophic costs. Institute bold policies and supportive systems for TB care and prevention. Intensify research and innovations for TB
